title: Were You Born in July
author: Great Aim Society
description: A birth-month text addressing readers born in July. It offers an example of popular character interpretation through the language of birth timing and its associated symbolic qualities.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/wereborninjuly00grea).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
